metadata.source: Nova Scotia GeoNAMES (Nova Scotia Geographic Names Database; CGNDB keys), map service https://nsgiwa.novascotia.ca/arcgis/rest/services/BASE/BASE_NS_GeoNAMES_pnt_UT83/MapServer (layers 3 Towns, 4 Villages, 5 First Nations, 6/7 Communities/Unincorporated, 10 Parks, 24 Islands, 31 Bays, 32 Channels, 33 Lakes, 37 Rivers); dataset https://data.novascotia.ca/d/xf3i-vxcb
metadata.coordinates: official NAD83 lat/lon from GeoNAMES, rounded to 5 dp (WGS84 for display; difference < 2 m)
metadata.priority: 1 = always show, 2 = show from zoom 10, 3 = show from zoom 12. First Nation communities (MUN2, e.g. Potlotek First Nation) are priority 2 so reserve land near St. Peter's is visible; the reserve parcels themselves (IR, e.g. Chapel Island 5) are priority 3.
metadata.notes: Duplicates across layers removed by CGNDB key. Lakes kept only if >= 20 ha (area from NSHN polygon containing the GeoNAMES point); Bras d'Or Lake is tidal and is drawn as sea. Rivers limited to generic "River" (brooks omitted). Mountains and capes omitted.
